Design Notes — Identity Lock

  • Black hair + white streak, cat ears, GOLD slit eyes, PALE skin — NOT grey skin.
  • Black kimono with PINK peony + pink obi; black FINGERLESS gloves — the red nails show through.
  • Twin tails + cat tail.
  • Vibrant magenta/purple dusk. Keep the reference's soft dreamy glow, bloom and painterly finish — never flat studio.
  • Pure Edo fantasy; no modern tech.
